name: 90067 · Los Angeles, CA
findings: ZIP 90067 (Los Angeles) has 330 nonprofit organizations. 86 of them (26%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 70 organizations.
Foundation organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 90067 (Los Angeles) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 90067 (Los Angeles) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 12.2 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 70 organizations here; 13% of all organizations here have no identified type.
